messages:
maya (VP People): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring & org changes. Dropping the plan here and opening for short Q&A.

sam (CTO): High-level: we're allocating headcount to production inference (runtime + infra) first, then product/GT. This is to hit our latency & reliability goals.

maya (VP People): Numbers: 28 net new headcount for the fiscal year. Hiring cadence: Q2 hiring burst (20 roles prioritized), steady Q3 hiring, and a small reserve for Q4.

jordan (eng-manager): Can you spell out which teams get the Q2 burst? need to plan interview panels.

maya (VP People): Q2 targets: eng-runtime ~10, eng-infra/eng-sre ~6, devex/docs ~4, product/solutions ~4. 4 roles are flexible reserves for urgent customer needs.

alex (product): Product roles = PM vs PO split? helps recruiting brief.

maya (VP People): Product split = 2 platform PMs, 1 Dedicated PM, 1 partner integrations PM. Lisa will circulate role briefs.

lisa (People Ops): Posting requisition templates + interview rubrics to #recruiting in ~30m. Please flag must-haves ASAP.

nina (IC): On org map: are teams being merged or just reporting lines adjusted?

sam (CTO): Mostly reporting line consolidation under Eng-Platform. No layoffs. A few small teams will move under single managers to reduce fragmentation.

omar (platform-eng): Will oncall rotations change if runtime gets a lot more hires?

sam (CTO): Short-term rotations same. New hires will shadow initially. If MTTR/page volume doesn't improve we'll add SRE-focused hires.

maya (VP People): To reiterate: no involuntary eliminations tied to this plan. This is reorg for clearer spans and fewer duplicated projects.

jordan (eng-manager): Can we get an affected-teams list (CSV is fine) so managers can prepare 1:1s?

maya (VP People): Yes. We'll publish a before/after team-mapping playbook with suggested manager talking points by EOD Thursday.

alex (product): Promotion cycles impacted? will calibration shift because of changes?

maya (VP People): Promotion cycles remain on schedule. We're updating role families to reflect cross-team expectations; optional calibration workshop next week.

nina (IC): SLA on req->offer for Q2 roles? past cycles had long tails.

lisa (People Ops): Target 6-8 weeks for senior ICs, 4-6 weeks for mid/junior. We're dedicating recruiters to the Q2 buckets. If you see bottlenecks, DM stage IDs.

omar (platform-eng): Candidate profiles for runtime: how heavy on CUDA/quantization vs systems design?

sam (CTO): Prefer strong systems + model-serving background. Quantization/LLM infra is a plus, not a blocker; willingness to learn framework specifics is acceptable.

maya (VP People): Next steps: Lisa posts reqs + rubrics; Sam & I host 30m manager Q&A Friday 10:00 to align messaging and priorities. DM us for anything sensitive.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Hiring sprint manager Q&A" Fri 10:00 — maya, sam, lisa.

jordan (eng-manager): Thanks — will review rubrics when posted and flag any interview stage issues.

nina (IC): Request: can we have a read-only tracker listing open reqs and stage (no PII) so teams can see pipeline health?

lisa (People Ops): Yes — we'll provide a read-only tracker. Expect link in #recruiting tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

maya (VP People): One ask: managers please document any role-specific interview bar matrices before interviews start. This helps speed decisions.

alex (product): Product will prepare sample PRDs & acceptance criteria to include with role briefs to help screen for product judgment.

sam (CTO): Main aim: keep delivery predictable while we scale hiring. We'll measure impact on sprint velocity and adjust hires if necessary.

maya (VP People): Closing: phased approach, careful manager transitions, and more comms to follow. If you have immediate concerns, escalate to me or Lisa. :sparkles:
